verdict.rationale: The evidence describes runtime design-quality checks the skill runs on the logos it produces: an SVG audit against logo principles, test sheets such as the 16 px pixel test, and self-review of rendered drafts. These check generated output and are not tests or evals that guard the skill's own behavior against regressions when it changes. That is an adjacent feature, and nothing in the evidence documents an eval suite, CI, or regression tests for the skill itself.
